name: Volatility-Adjusted Donchian Breakout
description: Long-only breakout strategy using 20-day Donchian Channel with ATR-based position sizing (2% risk) and dual-exit mechanism (Chandelier trailing stop + technical breakdown). Equalizes risk across Gold, Nasdaq, and Bitcoin.
source:
# Volatility-Adjusted Donchian Breakout Strategy
# Long-only with ATR-based position sizing and dual-exit mechanism

# Data source
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# Donchian Channel (20-day)
donchian_upper, donchian_middle, donchian_lower = donchian_channel(window=20)()

# ATR for volatility measurement (5-day)
atr_5 = atr(period=5)()

# Chandelier Exit (20-day lookback, 5-day ATR, 3x multiplier)
chandelier_long, chandelier_short, chandelier_dir = chandelier_exit(length=20, atr_length=5, multiplier=3.0)()

# Entry Logic: Close breaks above 20-day Donchian upper band
# Use lag to detect breakout (close > upper AND previous close <= previous upper)
prev_close = close >> 1
prev_upper = donchian_upper >> 1
long_entry = close > donchian_upper and prev_close <= prev_upper

# Exit Logic A: Chandelier Stop - price crosses below trailing stop
prev_chandelier = chandelier_long >> 1
chandelier_exit_signal = close < chandelier_long and prev_close >= prev_chandelier

# Exit Logic B: Technical Breakdown - close breaks below Donchian lower band
prev_lower = donchian_lower >> 1
breakdown_exit = close < donchian_lower and prev_close >= prev_lower

# Combined exit signal (first trigger wins)
exit_signal = chandelier_exit_signal or breakdown_exit

# Position management using hold_until
in_position = hold_until()(enter=long_entry, exit=exit_signal)

# Executor: Long zone
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=in_position)

# Risk Management: 2% risk, stop distance = 3 * ATR(5)
stop_distance = 3.0 * atr_5

# Position sizing using risk_unit (2% risk per trade)
risk_unit(
    rr_ratio=2.0,
    stop_unit=StopUnit.price
)(
    risk_pct=2.0,
    stop_distance=stop_distance,
    rebalance_on=long_entry
)

# Event Markers
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Trade Signals",
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Donchian Upper", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Donchian Lower", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Chandelier Stop", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="ATR(5)", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Show", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(
    "Long Entry" if long_entry else ("Chandelier Exit" if chandelier_exit_signal else ("Breakdown Exit" if breakdown_exit else "")),
    close,
    donchian_upper,
    donchian_lower,
    chandelier_long,
    atr_5,
    long_entry or chandelier_exit_signal or breakdown_exit
)

# Dashboard: Price with Donchian Channel
timeseries_lines(
    title="Price & Donchian Channel",
    category="Indicators",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Close", color=Color.White),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Donchian Upper", color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Donchian Middle", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Donchian Lower", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(close, donchian_upper, donchian_middle, donchian_lower)

# Dashboard: Chandelier Exit Stop
timeseries_lines(
    title="Chandelier Trailing Stop",
    category="Indicators",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Close", color=Color.White),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Chandelier Long Stop", color=Color.Emerald)
    ])
)(close, chandelier_long)

# Dashboard: ATR for volatility reference
timeseries_lines(
    title="ATR(5) - Volatility",
    category="Volatility",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ATR(5)", color=Color.Amber)
    ])
)(atr_5)

# Dashboard: Position status
position_indicator = 1.0 if in_position else 0.0
timeseries_lines(
    title="Position Status",
    category="Signals",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="In Position", color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, title="Threshold", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(position_indicator)
